reply_body: Sorry about the crash — the app closing right at launch after yesterday's update on your Redmi Note 12 (Android 13) isn't something you should be dealing with on a paid plan. I've passed your device and OS details to our engineering team so they can reproduce it against that build. In the meantime, clearing the app cache from Settings > Apps > Dhaba, or reinstalling the latest version from the Play Store, sometimes gets past a bad update. We'll update you here as soon as there's a fix.
summary: Paying user reports app crashing immediately on launch after latest update on Redmi Note 12, Android 13.
